overview: Built a fully automated YouTube content system that handles video uploads, SEO content generation, validation, scheduling, and publishing through Make.com.
The workflow takes a video with basic content details and automatically prepares and schedules it for YouTube without requiring manual uploads or YouTube Studio work.

list: Retrieves video files and content details from Google Drive, Google Sheets, or Airtable
Validates title length, description structure, and hashtag limits
Stops or alerts the workflow when content does not meet the required criteria
Applies the generated metadata and visibility settings
Schedules videos with predefined publishing gaps
Queues multiple videos for future publishing
Logs the completed process and results

blocks.p: The workflow automatically prepares each video for publishing and schedules content in advance.
Videos can be queued with predefined intervals such as every 7 to 10 days, allowing weeks or months of content to be scheduled at once.
The same automation can also branch into additional actions such as Instagram Reels publishing, Slack or email notifications, and Google Sheets reporting.
The workflow uses Google Drive, Google Sheets, or Airtable as the central content source.
This keeps the complete YouTube content pipeline organized and easy to manage.

result: A complete automated YouTube publishing pipeline that handles content preparation, SEO, validation, uploading, and scheduling with minimal manual work.
The system makes it possible to prepare and queue weeks or months of YouTube content in advance while keeping the entire publishing process organized through automation.
